X, Y, total = map(int, input().split())

MAX_SIZE = 200005
INFINITY_VAL = 1000000007

numerator = -1
denominator = -1

def evaluate(a, b):
    global numerator, denominator
    if a < 0:
        return
    if numerator == -1:
        numerator = a
        denominator = b
        return
    diff1 = abs(denominator * X - numerator * Y) * b
    diff2 = abs(b * X - a * Y) * denominator
    if diff1 > diff2:
        numerator = a
        denominator = b
    elif diff1 == diff2 and (b < denominator or (b == denominator and a < numerator)):
        numerator = a
        denominator = b

for i in range(1, total + 1):
    val = i * X // Y
    evaluate(val - 1, i)
    evaluate(val, i)
    evaluate(val + 1, i)

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
